descriptions.text: Enchanted Obsidian Bracelet of the Raggle Rouser. This item has been upgraded three times. Warning: this item has a 50% chance to permanently break if it's upgraded again. This murky bracelet is light and kinda stylish if you're one of those sad sacks who always wears black and complains about how nobody ever understands you. It's made of obsidian glass, which is actually a type of rock that only forms under extreme, lava-based circumstances. And interestingly enough, this is what you'll turn into if you don't treat this item with the respect it deserves. This bracelet imbues the following effects. +10 to Constitution. +5 to Dexterity. +15% Fire Resistance. Wearer may cast a level-10 Fireball spell once every twenty minutes.

recap.text: Carl pulls a black bracelet off the moon elf Akland before killing him, and Donut demands it the moment she reads its description. Its Fireball sends a beachball of flame into the flailing beast's pink stomach, then into Lucia Mar's chest inside the wooden pub, where the far wall bursts into flames and Mordecai tells her Fireball is an outdoor spell. A silver bracelet from her gold box puts one on every leg, and she can add no more.

beats.headline: Give it to me now
beats.text: Akland, the moon elf Samantha dragged back by the ankle, had a black bracelet on his arm, and Carl pulled it off before killing him. He offers it to Donut and asks whether she still has a couple of slots left. Black, glass, a plain bangle, she says, not as ugly as that wood anklet, and then she reads the description and gasps. Give it to me now, Carl. It appears on her front right leg, suddenly much smaller; she snorts and moves it to the front left. Don't use a fireball in a tight space, says Carl. I know how fire works, Carl.
beats.gist: Donut puts on a black bracelet Carl pulled off Akland, after reading its description and gasping.

beats.headline: A beachball of fire
beats.text: Carl's Protective Shell goes up too close to the boss and launches it straight into the night sky, with the ogre Areson, Carl assumes, still riding it. Donut gallops into the shell on Mongo. Shoot it, Carl shouts. Fireball! A beachball-sized ball of fire rises slowly, almost reluctantly, and blasts into the pink stomach of the flailing beast. It bursts into flames end to end, lands on top of the shield with a vicious splat, and slides off into the trees, stuck face down. Fireball is awesome, Donut cries.
beats.gist: Donut's bracelet fires a beachball-sized fireball from Mongo that bursts the flailing beast's pink stomach into flames.

beats.headline: An outdoor spell
beats.text: On the screen, Carl watches the fight in the treehouse pub. Donut is rooted by a snare, one paw stuck to the floorboards for ninety seconds. She fires a full-powered magic missile into Lucia Mar, and as Lucia starts to recover, Donut casts a Fireball into her chest. Lucia slams into the back wall, and the far wall of the wooden pub bursts into flames. Donut has already opened a platinum Did-You-Really-Just-Cast-Fireball-in-a-Room-This-Small box. Fireball is an outdoor spell, Donut, says Mordecai.
beats.gist: Snared Donut casts Fireball in a wooden pub, and Mordecai says it is an outdoor spell.

beats.headline: A bracelet on every leg
beats.text: Donut's own gold box holds a sparkling silver bracelet with little purple gems, and she equips it at once. She moves the obsidian bracelet that lets her cast Fireball to her right forward leg and puts the new one on the left. With the fallen oak anklet on one back leg and her plus-two dexterity bracelet on the other, she has a bracelet on all four legs and cannot add any more.
beats.gist: Donut equips a silver bracelet with purple gems, moves her Fireball bracelet, and wears one on every leg.
